description: Swaps one of your characters into a ready source video (or a reel link). Uses AI swap credits from your plan or a swap pack. Sharing plans and the Free plan include none: then the answer is code plan_limit with an upgrade_url to show the user. Returns the video id; poll get_video until ready (about 8 minutes). start/end: seconds of the source to swap (default: from the start, up to your plan limit).

source_url.description: Or a reel link (the worker downloads it)

subject.description: Who to replace, e.g. "the woman in red" (default: the main person)

name: start_swap
title: Start an AI character swap
